title: Recover abandoned Windows native build locks and surface queue diagnostics
body: The queued native build was cancelled from WSL after cmake.exe survived behind cmd.exe and retained Global\VixenConfigureLock; the next run waited, then surfaced an AbandonedMutexException without a queue-actionable diagnostic. I had to add exact Windows-child cleanup, PowerShell abandoned-mutex recovery, a 30-second heartbeat, and visible Ninja progress in the VIXEN launcher/build scripts. Consolidate cancellation ownership and R796 diagnostics in the shared native build facade.

title: Define JSON review graph to VXD or VRC bake contract
body: B01-B05 exist only as review JSON graphs, while PackRecipeSource accepts .vrc/.vxd and the authoring path documents render_recipe .vxd to VRC1. The queued Undertow.Author.Cli JSON bake and renderrecipetemp checks could not run because the current base has NamespacedId compile errors, so no supported JSON-to-VXD/VRC conversion was verified. Consolidate a documented bake/validation route that emits schemas.json, flattened recipe assets, and stable recipe ids for look-dev capture.

title: Add a queued native executable capture route with process cleanup
body: To exercise the freshly built Windows vixen_lookdev_capture.exe I had to cd into the native build directory, set WSLENV path conversion manually, and invoke cmd.exe /c .\vixen_lookdev_capture.exe because vixen-native.sh exposes batch-file routes but no direct executable/CTest route with cleanup and GPU queue semantics. Consolidate a first-class native capture command that forwards recipe inputs, owns the Windows child, and records per-recipe logs.
